messages:
zoe: dropping a quick thread on the Usage dashboard layout. two competing patterns: compact project cards (summary-first) vs full chronological ledger. figma: https://figma.com/s/usage-dashboard-v6

maya: Cards are cleaner for org-wide view. ledger good for digging into a single project. Concern: where to surface invoice downloads?

sam: Legal prefers explicit invoice linkage per line item. Suggest: cards show `Statement (PDF)` for the period; ledger rows show `Invoice #` link in expanded view.

anya: accessibility: don't rely on hover for cost info. chips must be keyboard-focusable and announce cost e.g. "4,200 tokens, $0.23". Toggle control needs clear aria-label and visible focus indicator.

pete: analytics: if we show grouped cards, include median + p95 token columns and a tiny sparkline so ops can spot noisy projects without expanding.

zoe: mock idea: default behavior = org scope -> cards (grouped), project scope -> ledger (list). keep a global toggle: "View: Grouped | List" next to scope pill. store per-account preference.

maya: micro-copy: swap "Token breakdown" -> "Usage details" to be less technical for new users.

sam: mobile: default to grouped cards with drill-in to ledger. Ledger is unreadable on phones otherwise.

anya: keyboard flow: expand should be Enter or Space when row/card focused; `aria-expanded` flips and focus moves into first detail cell. Provide skip links for long ledgers.

pete: perf note: grouped view needs aggregated API returning totals, median, p95, and sparkline points. backend flag suggestion: `aggregate_by=project,period`.

design-bot: new mock uploaded by maya at 2026-12-02T11:03:10Z 1: /figma/usage-cards-v2

zoe: next steps: maya to post two annotated mocks (cards-first + ledger-first) with ARIA notes and copy variants. anya to run a11y pass on prototype. sam to sync with legal on the "Statement" label. pete to scope API for aggregation. aiming for prototype next week.

maya: will post variants today, will include keyboard nav notes and invoice modal flow. thanks all :thumbsup:
